text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Trainer! I can't believe
it's
already here! Woo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where's Helios?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
For real? Aw, man. I guess it's just us
ringing in
the new year, then.
choice_data_list: I don't think they're coming today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
This is low key depressing, though. I'm
so used to
it being the three of us living
it up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Welp, no use moping about it. Let's just
party it
up like we always do! We gotta
celebrate a year
well spent!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So, what should we to do? Barbecue
some
traditional New Year's dishes? Put
on some huge
falsies, like the ones lion
dance puppets have?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Just thought I'd throw that out
there as a
suggestion. Not like there's a
way we can really
do that, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like it's hard for Mejiro Palmer
to keep
up her spark and energy without
her bestie
around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way, even if there's no
training today,
I'd still like to make a
New Year's resolution.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Like, I wanna decide what races I'm
gonna run in
and stuff! Let's see... If
we're talking about this
year's biggest
event, that's gotta be...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yikes! The Classic Triple Crown! Just the
title
carries so much pressure and
weight!
choice_data_list: The Classic Triple Crown, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But, yeah... I guess this is the year I'll
have to face
that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Man, getting categorized into different
years
kinda sucks, doesn't it? Like, it
doesn't matter
how talented you are.
You still gotta compete
with everyone
else in your year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's probably safe to say Ryan's at the
top of my
class. She's literally the
Mejiro's shining star of
speed...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna think of being on the same
stage as
her, even as a joke! I'm trying
my best, but the
skill gap between us is
so big...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh man, reality's coming at me fast!
There's only
one thing I can do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's run away, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's escape reality! Setting
resolutions is
great and all, but I'm
gonna revert back to my
straightlaced
self again at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Something fun, something fun... What's
something
fun and freeing we can do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer racks her brain to find an
escape
path. I try thinking of something
too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fieldwork! Yeah! That'll be the best way
to blow
off all this antsy energy of mine!
choice_data_list: Go on a boutique shopping spree.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's get changed and go! Time to break
away
and GO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer flies out the door in her
tracksuit. I
get the feeling I heard those
words before...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Raaaaah! Digging holes, harvesting
potatoes, and
getting muddy! That's
what I'm talking about!
Woo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Whatcha think of my handiwork, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Digging holes has been my thing since I
was a kid!
No one else is as fast as me
when it comes to
tilling.
choice_data_list: Incredible... The field became full of holes in an instant.
Incredible... The field was full of holes in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Why wait for a hole to open up when
you can dig
your own to jump into,
amirite? Anyway, see you
when I've
calmed down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She digs a hole with blazing speed and
buries
herself in it just as fast. This
unique skill of hers
leaves me
dumbfounded, and the new year is only

getting started.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Shopping?! I'm in! This is perfect timing
too since
sales are just about to start!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There's something I've had my eye on,
actually.
All right, shopping therapy,
here we come!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we go and arrive at none other
than...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Check these out, Trainer! Doesn't this
golf
apparel look great? Pretty exciting
stuff, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's buy them and take a walk around a
golf
course in our new threads! We can
get some nice,
fresh air that way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After impulse buying a full set of golf
apparel,
Mejiro Palmer forgets all about
her looming
competitions and enjoys a
leisurely afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a cafe! Good idea! Sunny gals like
me run on
yap sessions and sugar!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer! I'm seriously craving
this one
drink I haven't had in five-ever!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mix the lemonade in with the iced tea
and...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ta-dah! Behold, my very own classic
Palmer
blend!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Everyone would get mad at me
back home
because they think it's bad
manners to mix drinks,
but I just couldn't
stop doing it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Personally, this is my favorite mix, but
there're
tons of other great combos too.
Wanna try some?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We try fruit soda with milk, as well as
cola with
lemon tea. Both are better
than I expected. The
two of us enjoy
mixing up even more drinks
together.
choice_data_list: Yeah, might as well make the most of it.
Yeah, might as well since we have the chance.
